heading: Backstage
lede: Everything you change here goes live on the public site.
dragInstructions: Press space to pick this item up. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it, space again to drop it, or escape to cancel.
reorderHint: Drag the handles or use the arrows to change the order, then save it.
unsavedOrder: The new order is not saved yet.
networkError: the server didn’t answer. Check your connection and try again.

err.youtube: This doesn’t look like a YouTube link.
err.count: Use a whole number, 0 or more.

upload.idle: Paste a link or upload PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP4, WebM or MOV, up to 100 MB. You can also drop a file here.
upload.idleImage: Paste a link or upload PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 100 MB. You can also drop a file here.
upload.wrongType: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP4, WebM or MOV file.
upload.wrongTypeImage: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
upload.badUrl: Paste a full link that starts with https://

projects.sub: The archive, in the order visitors see it.
projects.emptyText: Add the first one. It stays hidden until you publish it.
projects.confirmDelete: Delete “{title}”? Its uploaded images are removed too. This can’t be undone.
projects.noCategories: No categories yet. Create one in the Categories tab.
projects.galleryCount: {count, plural, =0 {Gallery, empty} one {Gallery, # image} other {Gallery, # images}}
projects.coverHintYouTube: Optional. If blank, the YouTube thumbnail is used.
projects.coverHintGallery: Optional. If blank, the first gallery image is used.
projects.galleryEmpty: No images yet. They show in this order.
projects.supportNote: These texts appear only on the Support page. Turning this off keeps them for later.
projects.supportBodyHint: Start each section with a “## Heading” line and leave a blank line between paragraphs. Keep it short so the page fits one desktop screen.
projects.episodesHint: Leave both empty to hide the progress bar.

hero.sub: Slides for the home page hero.
hero.emptyText: Add an image or a short video to start the home page with.
hero.confirmDelete: Delete this slide? Its uploaded file is removed too.
hero.staticNote: The home page currently plays the fixed clips /videos/hero-1.mp4 and hero-2.mp4, so slides saved here don’t show there yet.
hero.mediaHint: An image, or an MP4 or WebM clip without sound.
hero.youtubeHint: Optional. Used when there is no image or video.
hero.needMedia: Add an image, a video or a YouTube link first.

categories.sub: Groups for the archive. Order here is the order of the filters.
categories.emptyText: Categories group projects in the archive. Add one, then assign projects to it.
categories.confirmDelete: Delete the category “{name}”? Its projects become uncategorized.
categories.projectCount: {count, plural, =0 {No projects} one {# project} other {# projects}}

submissions.sub: Messages from the contact form, newest first.
submissions.emptyText: When someone writes through the contact form, it lands here.
submissions.confirmDelete: Delete the message from {name}? This can’t be undone.
